subtitle: Cross-reference for 25/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, the SIX national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent, Datafolha BR-00304/2026, Palver BR-09587/2026, PoderData/Aya BR-01739/2026, Alfa Inteligência/TMC BR-02512/2026, Real Time Big Data BR-04202/2026 and Futura/100% Cidades BR-05268/2026, and the press flow of 25/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 43.50% (USD 12.21M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, with no move in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rises 0.85pp, to 25.35% (USD 0.99M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, the most recent, measure him from 43% at Palver, tied, to 38.4% at Futura, 2 points behind, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in one of the six.
fortes: The gap against Flávio Bolsonaro in the winner contract stays at 12.05pp, the same as in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, after three days running of narrowing from the 22.40pp of 21/Sep.
⚖️ His price stayed at 43.50% in all 8 points recorded in the backup between the two confirmed readings, from 00:00 to 14:30 BRT on 25/Sep.
In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rises 0.85pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 25.35%, with the sum of that pair going from 100.00 to 99.85.

At Datafolha on 24/Sep, the pollster with the highest reliability in the table, he leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by 40% to 36% and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 47% to 45%, and it is the only one of the six national polls of that day that puts him ahead head to head.

Measuring each house against its own previous wave, he gained ground in three of the six: Datafolha, where the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) gap widened from 3 to 4 points, Palver, where he went from 1 point behind to a tie, and PoderData, where the lead widened from 1 to 2 points.

🔒 Datafolha of 24/Sep measures how locked in the choice is ten days before the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno): 80% of the electorate say they are completely decided, and among his voters the figure is 87%, the highest on either side.
fracos: He is still behind in the winner contract by 12.05pp, with 43.50% against 55.55% for Flávio Bolsonaro.
In the series recorded since 14 April his price sits 24.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 9.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.

🔴 He loses ground in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, always against the previous wave of the same pollster: at Real Time his lead fell from 8 to 4 points, at Futura he went from 0.6 point ahead to 2 points behind, and at Alfa, Exame reports a fall from 14 to 7 points in the pollster's own series.

⚖️ In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing he loses in four of the six houses, and at Futura the deficit of 5.7 points, 43.7% against 49.4%, falls OUTSIDE the 2.2pp margin of that poll.
📊 Approval measured on 24/Sep runs from 41% at PoderData to 47% at Datafolha, and disapproval stands between 50% and 55% in the five pollsters of that day that the panel records.

📰 The messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone, published by Estadão on 24/Sep, reach both sides of the race: on his side, a lawyer reports thanks for whisky sent by the banker and an effort to bring him closer to the government. He replied publicly, at an event in Rio, that a president friend is the people, and not Vorcaro.
candidates.analise: Lula stayed at 43.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.21M cumulative volume) in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, exactly the price of the reading confirmed on 24/Sep at 22:45 BRT, and also at 43.50% in the 8 points recorded in the backup between the two. The gap against Flávio Bolsonaro stays at 12.05pp, after three days running of narrowing from the 22.40pp of 21/Sep, and the pair sum stood at 99.05 in both readings, so the normalized move is also zero. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rises 0.85pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 25.35%. 🗳️ There was no new national poll on 25/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep still do not agree about him: in the first round they run from 7 points ahead at Alfa/TMC to 2 points behind at Futura, and in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) he leads only at Datafolha, by 47% to 45%. Measuring each pollster against its own previous wave, the count comes out 3 to 3. 📰 On the campaign trail, he defended ending betting sites at a campaign rally, as Folha de S.Paulo, G1 and VEJA report. ⛔ The panel does not attribute the price to the polls or to the news flow: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 55.55% (USD 11.83M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, with no move in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp, to 74.50% (USD 1.16M). POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep, the most recent, measure him from 40.4% at Futura, where he leads, to 33% at Alfa/TMC, and he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six.
fortes: He is still ahead in the winner contract by 12.05pp, with 55.55% against 43.50%, and his price sits 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% recorded on 21/Sep.
⚖️ Between the two confirmed readings his price ranged from 54.30% to 56.30% in the points recorded in the backup and returned to the same 55.55%, and the gap stopped at 12.05pp.

⭐ He leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing in four of the six national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent: 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, 48% to 45% at Palver, 46% to 45% at PoderData and 45% to 44% at Real Time, with a 43% tie at Alfa.

📌 The Futura advantage, of 5.7 points, is the only one of the six that falls OUTSIDE the margin of the poll itself, and the house describes it as a statistical advantage. It is not the first time in this base: of the 34 [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) readings between the two already recorded in the panel, 11 fell outside the margin and 8 of them favoured him.

He gains ground in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep when each pollster is measured against its own previous wave: he rose 7 points at Real Time, 2.7 at Futura, where he took the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) lead, and Exame reports that he cut the distance from 14 to 7 points in the Alfa series.
fracos: The gap over Lula, which narrowed for three days running, from 22.40pp on 21/Sep to 19.05pp, 18.35pp and 12.05pp, did not reopen in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep.
🔴 In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 74.50%, with the sum of that pair going from 100.00 to 99.85.

He leads the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in only one of the six national polls of 24/Sep, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and trails in the other five, with the widest distance at Alfa/TMC, 33% against 40%.

📰 Messages extracted from Daniel Vorcaro phone and published by Estadão on 24/Sep show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with its own sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and he confirmed an exchange from September 2025 about it, citing a private financing contract that was not made public.

On the same day he asked the Supreme Court, in André Mendonça chambers, to investigate the relationship between Lula and Vorcaro, and Folha de S.Paulo records that the request comes from someone who is under investigation in the Dark Horse case.
🗣️ On 25/Sep Estadão reports that he said he tried to speak with Daniel Vorcaro in the four days before the banker's arrest to discuss the film Dark Horse.
candidates.analise: Flávio Bolsonaro stayed at 55.55% in the winner contract (USD 11.83M cumulative volume) in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, exactly the price of the reading confirmed on 24/Sep at 22:45 BRT, but not still: in the 8 points recorded in the backup between the two, his price ranged from 54.30% to 56.30%. The gap over Lula stays at 12.05pp, and his price is 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.00pp raw and 0.89pp normalized, to 74.50%. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep, which are still the most recent, he leads the first round in one, Futura, by 40.4% to 38.4%, and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of the six, with Futura's 5.7 point lead as the only one outside the margin. 📰 On the campaign trail, he called the government's measure against betting sites hypocritical and electioneering, as Folha de S.Paulo, O Globo and Poder360 report, and Estadão reports that he said he tried to speak with Daniel Vorcaro in the four days before the banker's arrest to discuss the film Dark Horse.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract (USD 5.02M cumulative volume) and 41.05% (USD 0.28M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, up 1.10pp raw and down 0.11pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
fortes: Rises 1.10pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 41.05%.

🔑 PoderData tests him in a pairing that contradicts the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) order: he beats Lula by 45% to 42%, the same score as the house wave of 17/Sep, and loses to Flávio Bolsonaro by 39% to 41%.
He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in three of the six national polls of 24/Sep, with 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time.
📰 On 25/Sep, in Recife, he defended raising taxes on betting sites and said he backs neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro in a possible [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), as G1 reports.
fracos: 🔴 The 1.10pp rise in the third place book is overround: the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it he GIVES UP 0.11pp. The distance to Renan Santos widens from 4.05pp to 4.45pp raw.
He gives way at Datafolha, from 6% to 5%, and at PoderData, from 8% to 6%, always against the previous wave of the same house.
At Futura he lost third place to Ronaldo Caiado: he fell from 6.5% to 5.6% while the other rose from 4.5% to 5.7%.
In the winner contract he remains at the floor of the book, 0.05%, and is priced below what his cumulative volume would suggest, USD 5.02M.
At Palver, which is the source of the polling side of the divergence chart in this round, he has only 2%.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 1.10pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 41.05% (USD 0.28M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, but the rise is overround: the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it he gives up 0.11pp. The distance to Renan Santos widens from 4.05pp to 4.45pp raw, in the series of certified readings 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp, 4.05pp and 4.45pp. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 2% at Palver to 6% at Alfa, PoderData and Real Time, and PoderData has him beating Lula in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) by 45% to 42%, repeating the score of 17/Sep. 📰 On 25/Sep, in Recife, he said he backs neither Lula nor Flávio Bolsonaro in a possible second round, as G1 reports.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.70% (USD 14.44M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, up 0.15pp, and 45.50% (USD 0.41M cumulative volume) in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place contract, up 1.50pp raw and 0.17pp normalized by the book sum, in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT. POLL: the six national polls of 24/Sep measure him from 2.4% at Futura to 8% at Palver.
fortes: He keeps the lead of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, at 45.50%, and his edge over Augusto Cury widens from 4.05pp to 4.45pp raw.
🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the LARGEST cumulative volume in the presidential race, USD 14.44M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's.

🔑 And in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up book too: USD 1.36M, above the USD 1.16M of Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which is the one paying 74.50% there. Volume does not follow price in either book.
📰 According to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called him a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.
He is the most voted of the third way at Palver, with 8%, and second at Real Time, with 6%.
fracos: ⚖️ The 1.50pp rise in the third place book is almost all overround: the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it his gain is 0.17pp.
🔴 He falls from 11% to 8% at Palver against the house wave of 21/Sep, the largest fall of any name in that poll.

⚠️ The six national polls of the SAME day measure him at 8% at Palver, 6% at Real Time, 3% at Datafolha and at PoderData and 2.4% at Futura: the highest reading is more than three times the lowest, and because the six came out on the same day that distance cannot be put down to the calendar.
In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairings he is the most distant opponent from Lula: 34% to 44% at Palver and 37% to 43% at Alfa.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos rose 1.50pp raw in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book, to 45.50% (USD 0.41M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, but almost all of it is overround: the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it the gain is 0.17pp. The distance to Augusto Cury widens from 4.05pp to 4.45pp raw. In the winner contract he rises 0.15pp, to 0.70%. 🏆 His contract in the winner book is still the one with the largest cumulative volume in the presidential race, USD 14.44M against USD 14.10M for Tarcísio de Freitas's, and the same happens in the runner-up book, USD 1.36M against USD 1.16M for Flávio Bolsonaro's contract, which pays 74.50% there. 🗳️ In the six national polls of 24/Sep he runs from 8% at Palver to 2.4% at Futura, and since all six came out on the same day that distance cannot be attributed to timing. 📰 According to Estadão of 25/Sep, The Economist called him a combative libertarian and named him the most suitable candidate.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, at the floor of the book, with USD 7.55M cumulative. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for governor of São Paulo, and none of the six national polls of 24/Sep tests him in a presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract did not move in this reading, so there is no move to explain, and his series high in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by any of the six national polls of the day nor tested in a [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) pairing, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him in this round. His winner contract has accumulated USD 7.55M, a larger volume than that of Augusto Cury, who is tested by the six houses and has USD 5.02M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT, below the 0.5% floor of the double reading, with USD 7.71M cumulative. zema.fracos: He stays at the floor of the winner book, 0.05%, and at 0.35% in the third place book. cruzamento: The day has both instruments standing still in different places. 💹 In the winner contract, the reading confirmed on 25/Sep, 17:08 BRT exactly repeats the one of 24/Sep at 22:45 BRT: Flávio Bolsonaro at 55.55%, Lula at 43.50% and the gap at 12.05pp, after three days running of narrowing from the 22.40pp of 21/Sep. ⚖️ An unchanged price does not mean a still book: in the 8 points recorded in the backup between the two readings, Flávio Bolsonaro's price ranged from 54.30% to 56.30% and returned to the same place, while Lula's stayed at 43.50% in all of them. 🔀 In the neighbouring books the raw figure misleads. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third place book the three leading names rise raw, Renan Santos 1.50pp, to 45.50%, Augusto Cury 1.10pp, to 41.05%, and Ronaldo Caiado 0.50pp, to 14.50%, but the sum of the whole book went from 99.25 to 102.25, and normalized by it the move ranges from a gain of 0.17pp to a loss of 0.11pp. In the runner-up book Flávio Bolsonaro gives up 1.00pp, to 74.50%, and Lula rises 0.85pp, to 25.35%, with 0.89pp each way normalized. 🗳️ No new national poll came out on 25/Sep, and the six from 24/Sep are still the most recent, without agreeing on who leads either round: measuring each pollster against its own previous wave, three moved toward Lula and three toward Flávio Bolsonaro. The [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registry sets the next one, Veritá with n=40,500, for 26/Sep. 📰 In the day's news, two procedural acts in the Master case: the Superior Council of the Federal Prosecution Service formed a majority against removing Paulo Gonet from the proceedings and, on opening an internal inquiry into his conduct, stood at 4 to 3 in favour with two votes still to be cast, and Edson Fachin gave the Prosecutor General's Office five days to weigh in on the pending requests in the Master and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) investigations. On the campaign trail, Lula defended ending betting sites and Flávio Bolsonaro called the measure electioneering. ⛔ The panel does not attribute price moves to polls or to acts: it measures both sides, each with its own timestamp.
